app.name: OpenMasjid Students
app.tagline: The madrasa office in one app

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to your madrasa's office
auth.setupSubtitle: First-run setup — this account manages everything on the masjid network.
auth.resetRequestSubtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
auth.resetSent: If that email is registered, we've sent a link to reset your password. Please check your inbox.
auth.resetInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been updated. You can now sign in.
auth.adminTunnelNote: Admin sign-in only works on the masjid network. Teachers, finance and parents can sign in from anywhere.
auth.setupOnLanBody: Set up the admin account from a device on the masjid’s own Wi-Fi — for safety, the first admin can’t be created over the internet.
auth.changeSubtitle: Please choose a new password to continue.
auth.parentUsernameIsEmail: Parents: your username is your email address.

home.title: You’re signed in
home.next: Your role’s dashboard arrives in the next steps — attendance, grades, billing and the family portal.

picker.placeholder: Type a name or Student ID…

siblings.title: Any siblings?
siblings.intro: Linking brothers and sisters puts them in one household, so one set of guardian details, one balance and one portal login covers them all.
siblings.contactIntro: {{count}} group(s) share a phone number or email address between their guardians — those are almost certainly siblings, so they’re ticked ready to link.
siblings.surnameIntro: {{count}} group(s) only share a surname. That happens a lot with unrelated families, so nothing is ticked — have a look and tick the ones that really are siblings.
siblings.linkedMerged: Linked {{count}} students, merged {{merged}} duplicate guardian record(s)
siblings.none: Nothing looks like a sibling group right now — every student is either already in a household with their brothers and sisters, or has nothing in common with anyone else on file.
siblings.laterHint: You can always link siblings later from any student’s record.

enrol.title: Enrol students
enrol.hint: Tick everyone who belongs in this class and enrol them in one go. You can still set a class one student at a time on the Students tab.
enrol.currentHint: To take a student out of this class, set their class on the Students tab.
enrol.allPlaced: Every student is already in a class. Switch to “In another class” or “Everyone” to move some here.
enrol.doneSkipped: Enrolled {{count}} student(s). {{skipped}} were skipped — they’re no longer active.

directory.title: Directory
directory.empty: No families yet. Add your first family to get started.
directory.name: Name
directory.feePlanHint: Every student needs a fee plan, so they’re included when invoices are generated.
directory.noFeePlans: Create a fee plan under Billing first.
directory.addSiblingHint: Pick a child who was added separately and they join this household — the guardians and emergency contacts on this record then apply to them too. If they already have siblings on file, those children come across as well.
directory.confirmUnlink: Move {{name}} into a household of their own? Their bills and payments go with them; the guardians stay on this record.
directory.resetNeedsEmail: Add an email address for this guardian first — use Edit.
directory.guardianEditHint: Guardians belong to the family, so this updates them everywhere. Clearing a field removes it.
directory.mailSent: Emailed — the link below is the same one, in case they don’t get it.
directory.mailNoUrl: Not emailed: this app has no public web address yet, so the link would only work on the masjid network. Turn on Remote access for OpenMasjid Students in OpenMasjidOS, or share the link below directly.
directory.mailNoTransport: Not emailed: no email is set up yet. Add SMTP under Settings, or set up email in OpenMasjidOS — or just share the link below.
directory.mailNotSent: Couldn’t send the email. Share the link below instead.
directory.confirmDelete: Delete {{name}} for good? This can’t be undone.
directory.confirmDeleteWithExtras: Delete {{name}} for good? Their fee plan and any charges not yet invoiced go with them. This can’t be undone.
directory.deleteBlocked: {{name}} has already been billed, so their record is part of your invoice history and can’t be deleted. Mark them withdrawn instead — that stops future billing and keeps the record.
directory.deleteBlockedPaid: A payment has been recorded for {{name}}, so their record is part of your payment history and can’t be deleted. Mark them withdrawn instead — that stops future billing. If the payment was really for another child, reverse it under Billing first, then record it against the right one.
directory.idHint: A Student ID is created automatically. To pay at the kiosk or on the donation site, a parent types that ID, checks the name it shows, then can pay for any of their children from there. It’s printed on the statement.
directory.confirmGuardianDelete: Delete {{name}} from this family? Their contact details are removed for good.
directory.confirmGuardianDeleteAccount: Delete {{name}} from this family? They have a parent portal account, and it will be removed too — they won’t be able to sign in, and you’d need to invite them again. Their children, bills and payments are not affected.
directory.confirmGuardianUnlink: {{name}} is also on {{count}} other family, so they’ll only be removed from this one. Their details stay on that other record.
directory.inviteHint: Creates a one-time sign-up link (valid 7 days) — copy it to the guardian. They need an email on file.
directory.mailPaused: Not sent — email to parents is paused in Settings. Use the link below.

students.title: Students
students.empty: No students yet — add your first student, or import a CSV.
students.name: Name
students.noSibling: — no, first child in the family —
students.linkSiblingHint: Pick a brother or sister and they share one household, so the guardian details already on file apply to this child too.

import.title: Import students
import.intro: Upload a spreadsheet or CSV and match its columns to the fields below. Nothing is saved until you review the result. Each student becomes one household of their own — link brothers and sisters afterwards, on either child’s record.
import.emptyFile: That file has no rows we could read.
import.matchHint: {{file}} — {{rows}} rows. We guessed these; change anything that looks wrong.
import.idsGenerated: Student IDs are always generated here — they can’t be imported from a file.
import.defaultPlanHint: Used for any row without a Fee plan column. Every student needs a plan, or the row is rejected.
import.siblingsNote: Siblings aren’t worked out from the file — guessing a family from a spreadsheet and getting it wrong would merge two families’ money. Every student becomes their own household, and the next step offers you the likely brothers and sisters to link.
import.siblingsStepIntro: Each of these students is in a household of their own. Link the brothers and sisters now and one set of guardian details, one balance and one portal login covers them all. You can skip this and do it later from any student’s record.
import.siblingsNext: Any siblings you did not link are each in a household of their own. Open one and use Add a sibling whenever you are ready.
import.fixFirst: Fix these rows in the CSV and upload it again — nothing is imported while any row has a problem.
import.idsAssigned: These are the Student IDs each child was given. They’re also on every student’s record and on their family’s statement — and the ID sheet below gives you the whole roster, by class, on one page you can print.
import.pickFileHint: An Excel workbook (.xlsx) or a CSV. Exported straight from your old system is fine — you don’t need to tidy it up first.
import.tooManyRows: That file has {{count}} rows, and an import can take {{max}} at a time. Split it into a few files and import them one after another.
import.extraRowsHint: If your file names a student once and then gives each extra parent or relative a row of their own, those rows are added to the student above them — so a 40-line file can be 25 students.
import.mergedNote_one: {{count}} line had no name of its own, so its contact details were added to the student above it. Check the People column.
import.mergedNote_other: {{count}} lines had no name of their own, so their contact details were added to the student above them. Check the People column.
import.placeContactsIntro: A father or a mother is added as a parent automatically. These relationships could be either — decide once for each and everybody with that relationship follows. A child whose only listed adult is a relative keeps them as a guardian either way, so the household still has somebody the office can contact.
import.asGuardianHint: A parent or guardian appears on the family record, can be invited to the parent portal, and is who you ring about tuition.
import.asEmergencyHint: An emergency contact is just a name, a number and what they are to the child — no portal access, and no email address is kept for them.

file.oldXls: That looks like an older Excel file (.xls). Open it in Excel and use Save As to make a .xlsx or a CSV, then upload that.
file.notZip: We could not read that file as a spreadsheet or a CSV. If it came from another program, export it again as .xlsx or CSV.
file.zip64: That workbook is far larger than a class roster. Save the sheet you need as its own .xlsx or CSV and upload that.
file.noSheet: There are no worksheets in that file — check you uploaded the right one.
file.noInflate: This browser cannot open .xlsx files. Save the sheet as a CSV and upload that instead.
file.tooBig: That workbook is too large to read here. Save the sheet you need as its own file and upload that.
file.compression: That workbook is packed in a way we cannot read. Open it in Excel and use Save As to make a fresh .xlsx or CSV.

import.feesIntro: Every imported student was given the same plan, because a spreadsheet cannot say "the second child pays less". Now that the brothers and sisters are grouped, change anyone’s plan or amount here. Leave the amount at the plan’s own price and they simply follow the plan — including any later change you make to it.
import.feeBadAmount: That amount isn’t a number we can read — try 350 or 350.00.
import.feesLater: You can change any of this later on a student’s own record, or for a whole class at once from Billing.

year.title: Year view
year.noYear: No school year yet. Set one up under Structure, then invoices and this grid line up to it.
year.needsStartYear: “{{label}}” has no starting calendar year, so its months can’t be worked out. Add one under Structure → School years.
year.columnsWarning: Extra columns land on this page and on anything you print from it — the contact ones put phone numbers and email addresses on a whole-school sheet, so switch on only what you need. Numbers and addresses are tappable: on a phone, one tap calls or emails. “Other” covers guardians with no relation set, including everyone brought in by a CSV import.
year.legend: ✓ paid · ½ part-paid · ● not paid yet · — voided · blank means no invoice for that month yet. A dimmed column is a month from before you started billing here.
year.beforeStart: This month is before your first billed month, so nothing was ever invoiced for it. Set when you went live (Billing → mid-year setup).

structure.title: Structure
structure.schoolsHint: Add a second school if your madrasah runs programmes on different calendars — a weekend maktab and a full-time hifz programme, say. Each school gets its own school year and its own classes. Everything else is shared: fee plans, staff, payments, and families. A parent with a child in each still gets one balance and one sheet.
structure.yearsHint: The billing calendar. A madrasa year usually runs across two calendar years — April to March, say — and the months you set here become the columns on the year view and the periods invoices are generated for.
structure.wrapHint: A year that ends before it starts runs into the next calendar year — April to March is twelve months.
structure.termsHint: Only needed if you charge tuition per term. A fee plan set to “per term” is billed on term periods; monthly plans ignore terms entirely.
structure.termsNeedYear: Add a school year first — terms belong to one.
structure.noTerms: No terms — this year is billed by month.
structure.coursesHint: How the roster is grouped. A course holds classes; a student sits in one class. This is for organising and billing only — no teachers, attendance or grades. Until a class exists, every student shows as unplaced.
structure.noCourses: No courses yet. Add one, then add its classes — the Students tab groups by these.
structure.courseArchived: Archived “{{name}}” and its classes. Students in them are now unplaced.

mass.title: Mass apply
mass.feeHint: Puts a fee plan on every student you pick. Safe to run twice — a student who already has the plan is skipped, never charged twice.
mass.chargeHint: Adds a one-off line for every student you pick. This is NOT repeat-safe: applying it twice bills twice.
mass.periodHint: Leave “Bill in” empty to put the charge on the next invoice generated for each family; set it to a month like 2026-07 to attach it to that month.
mass.negativeHint: A negative amount is a credit — use it to refund or discount a student without touching an invoice already raised.
mass.noStructure: No courses or classes yet — set them up under Structure, or pick students directly.
mass.feeResult: Assigned to {{assigned}} of {{targeted}}. {{skipped}} already had it.
mass.chargeResult: Charged {{created}} of {{targeted}}. {{attached}} went onto an invoice that was already open; the rest wait for the next generation.
mass.confirmCharge: Charge {{count}} students? This adds a new line each time it runs.

schedule.title: Weekly schedule
schedule.manualHint: Add each weekly session — you’ll be warned (never blocked) if a teacher or room is double-booked.
schedule.warnTeacher: {{teacher}} is also teaching {{class}} at this time.
schedule.warnRoom: {{room}} is also booked for {{class}} at this time.
schedule.pickToView: Pick one to see its week.

teach.weekIntro: Here’s your teaching week. Open a class to see its roster and subjects.
teach.noSessions: You have no scheduled sessions yet. The office sets the timetable.
teach.noClasses: You’re not assigned to any classes yet.
teach.classDenied: This class isn’t assigned to you.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.pastDate: Editing a past day — this change is recorded.
attendance.discardUnsaved: You have unsaved attendance for this day. Switch date and discard it?

gradebook.title: Gradebook
gradebook.noItems: No assignments yet. Add one to start grading.
gradebook.overMax: That score is above the maximum of {{max}}.
gradebook.saveFailed: That score couldn’t be saved. Please try again.
gradebook.confirmDelete: Delete “{{title}}” and all its scores? This can’t be undone.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.hint: The transcript is the student's cumulative record across all closed terms. Regenerating keeps old versions; publish makes the latest visible to parents (portal coming soon).

exams.title: Exams
exams.noExams: No exams in this term yet.
exams.noTerms: Add a term (in Classes) before creating exams.
exams.noClasses: No classes in this term yet.
exams.noSubjects: This class has no subjects to grade.
exams.confirmUnassign: Remove this exam from the class? Any marks entered for it will be deleted.
exams.noneAssigned: No exams assigned to this class yet. The office sets these up.
exams.cellHint: Type a mark, or “a” for absent, “e” for exempt. Leave blank if not yet marked.
exams.overMax: That mark is above the maximum of {{max}}.
exams.saveFailed: That mark couldn’t be saved. Please try again.
exams.remarkPlaceholder: Optional remark for this student’s report card

whatsNew.title: What’s new
whatsNew.introRunning: Release notes for OpenMasjid Students, up to the v{{version}} you’re running.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcomeBody: Manage your madrasa — families, students, classes and records. Pick a section below.

classes.setCurrentHint: Double-click to make this the current term
classes.noTerms: Add a term to start creating classes.
classes.noClasses: No classes in this term yet.
classes.subjectsHint: Comma-separated, e.g. Sabaq, Sabqī, Manzil, Tajwīd
classes.confirmClose: Close this term? Each student's final grade will be frozen from the current exam marks. You can reopen to make changes.
classes.closedNote: This term is closed — final grades are frozen. Reopen to make changes.

staff.title: Staff
staff.name: Name
staff.tempHint: At least 12 characters — changed on first sign-in
staff.resetPwHint: They’ll be asked to choose their own password the next time they sign in.
staff.roleHint: Finance runs billing and can work from home over the internet. Admin can change everything, including settings, and can only sign in on the masjid network. Changing someone’s role takes effect straight away — they don’t need to sign out.
staff.formHint: Enter a username and a temporary password of at least 12 characters.

settings.title: Settings
settings.reachHint: Invites, password resets and receipts all depend on these. If one is missing, the office can still share links by hand — but nothing will be emailed.
settings.reachUrlFrom_env: From the address set when this app was installed.
settings.reachUrlFix: Parents can’t open a link that only works on the masjid network. In OpenMasjidOS, go to Settings → Remote access and turn on sharing for OpenMasjid Students.
settings.reachMailPlatform: Provided by OpenMasjidOS — nothing to set up here.
settings.reachMailFix: This app isn’t connected to OpenMasjidOS yet, so it can’t send email. Invites and resets will be copy/print links until it is.
settings.reachSelfRegBlocked: The setting is on, but sign-up needs both an email set-up and a public web address, because the confirmation link is emailed.
settings.schoolHint: Shown on report cards and statements.
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 512 KB. Used on printed statements and every email the app sends. A plain logo on a transparent or white background photocopies best.
settings.logoEmailNeedsUrl: Statements will show your logo right away. Emails can only show it once Remote access is on for this app in OpenMasjidOS — an email has to load the image from a web address. Send a test email to see exactly what parents will get.
settings.appearanceHint: Your contact details go on the family information sheet, the statement, and the foot of every email to a parent — so “tell the office” actually tells them how. The date format and colour apply everywhere, printed and on screen.
settings.dateFormatHint: Applies everywhere, and to dates you type into a CSV import. Dates are always stored the same way, so changing this is safe.
settings.accentHint: The rules and headings on printed sheets.
settings.logoTooBig: That image is over 512 KB. Export it smaller and try again.
settings.paymentsHint: Choose which of your OpenMasjidOS Stripe accounts tuition is collected into. This is used for card payments in the parent portal and for the tuition option on your donation site and kiosk.
settings.externalPayments: Accept tuition at your donation site & kiosk
settings.externalPaymentsHint: When on, families can pay their balance with their child's Student ID on your masjid's donation site and kiosk. Turn it off to hide tuition there — the parent portal is unaffected.
settings.paymentsNoAccounts: No Stripe accounts found. Add one in OpenMasjidOS (Settings → Payments), then reopen this page.
settings.paymentsNotReady: Card payments aren't ready yet — pick an account above (and make sure it's fully set up in OpenMasjidOS).
settings.meritOnReportCard: Show merit points on report cards
settings.selfRegistration: Let parents sign themselves up (with their child’s Student ID + an on-file email)
settings.selfRegistrationHint: Needs email set up. Turn off to require an office invite instead.
settings.customFieldsHint: Define fields once — they apply to every student’s record (e.g. previous madrasa, juz at intake, walī name).
settings.meritCategoriesHint: Categories teachers award points against, each with a default value (editable per award).
settings.commentBankHint: Reusable remark snippets all teachers can insert into term remarks and report cards.
settings.snippetHint: e.g. Mashā’Allāh, excellent progress this term.
settings.mailTestOk: Sent. If it doesn’t arrive, check the spam folder and the email set-up in OpenMasjidOS.
settings.alertsHint: What the school emails parents, and who at the masjid gets told when something needs a person.
settings.alertsNoMail: Email isn’t set up in OpenMasjidOS yet, so nothing can be sent. These settings are saved and will start working as soon as it is.
settings.parentReceipt: A receipt every time they pay
settings.parentReceiptHint: However the money arrived — in the portal, by autopay, at the kiosk, on the donation site, or cash you recorded here.
settings.parentAutopay: A notice when their card is declined
settings.parentAutopayHint: Sent on each failed autopay attempt, and again when autopay switches itself off after the third.
settings.parentAlwaysHint: Invites and password resets always send — they’re the only way a parent can reach their account. The pause above is the one exception — it holds those too.
settings.staffAlerts: Who to tell at the masjid
settings.staffAlertsHint: Add any address — the treasurer, the imām, a trustee. It grants no access to the app; it only receives the alerts you tick. Alerts can name a household and an amount, so add addresses you trust.
settings.alertAddHint: New addresses start on the alerts that cost money or hide a problem. Tick the rest yourself.
settings.parentMailPauseHint: Nothing at all is sent to a parent while this is on — not receipts, not autopay notices, and not invites or password resets. Turn it on while you are setting up or testing with your real families in the system, so nothing goes out by accident. Staff alerts and your own test sends are unaffected.
settings.parentMailPausedNotice: Email to parents is paused. Invites and resets still give you a link to copy or print, and nothing is being sent.

student.noFields: No custom fields defined. Add them in Settings.

billing.label: Label
billing.recordHint: Recorded against one child — it goes into their balance and covers their oldest unpaid bill first. Anything left over stays as their credit and comes off their next invoice. Paid for two children? Record it twice.
billing.confirmReverse: Reverse this payment? A reversal entry will be added.
billing.noPlansFinance: No fee plans yet — an admin sets these up on the masjid network.
billing.confirmPlanDelete: Delete “{{name}}” for good? It has never been billed, so nothing in your history changes. {{count}} student(s) on it stop being billed for it. This can’t be undone.
billing.confirmPlanArchive: “{{name}}” appears on {{count}} invoice line(s), so it can’t be deleted — your invoice history has to keep meaning what it said. Archive it instead? It disappears from this list and every student on it stops being billed for it; past invoices and payments are untouched.
billing.generateHint: Creates one invoice per family (from assigned fees) for this period. Re-running the same period changes nothing.
billing.reconcileHint: Check Stripe for any card payments that didn't come through automatically — from the donation site, the kiosk, or the parent portal — and record the ones that are missing. This runs on its own each day; use it if a payment seems to be missing.
billing.reconcileDone: Checked {{scanned}} payment(s) — recorded {{recorded}} that were missing.
billing.reconcileUnavailable: Card payments aren't set up yet, so there's nothing to sync.
billing.printInvoiceHint: Print this bill on its own — one child, one period, line by line, on your letterhead.
billing.autoHint: Runs overnight. Only bills months inside your current school year, only once per month, and catches up if the app was switched off on the day. Leave “Due on day” empty for no due date.
billing.autoWhy_no_school_year: No school year is set as current — set one up under Structure first.
billing.autoWhy_needs_start_year: The current school year has no starting calendar year, so its months can’t be worked out. Add one under Structure.
billing.autoWhy_outside_school_year: This month isn’t part of the current school year, so nothing was billed.
billing.autoWhy_too_early: Not yet — it runs on the day you chose.
billing.autoWhy_already_done: This month’s invoices have already been generated.
billing.overrideHint: Charges this student a different amount for the same plan — no need to create another plan. Leave the amount empty to put them back on the plan’s price.
billing.itemsHint: A short list of the things you charge for besides tuition — a uniform, an exam fee, a trip. Applying one copies its name and price onto the charge, so re-pricing an item here never changes a charge already raised.
billing.noItems: No items yet. You can still add a one-off charge without one.
billing.itemEditHint: Changes the price for charges added from now on. Charges already raised keep the amount they were given.
billing.chargeHint: Lands on this period’s open invoice straight away if there is one; otherwise it waits for the next generation. A negative amount is a credit. Once it’s on an invoice it can’t be voided — add a negative charge instead.
billing.findStudent: Search a name or Student ID
billing.nothingDue: Nothing is due for this child right now. Anything you record is held as their credit and the next bill takes it.
billing.nothingDueCredit: Nothing is due — {{amount}} is already in hand for this child, and their next bill will take it.
billing.owesLines: Owes {{amount}} — tick what this payment is for:
billing.tickedHint: {{count}} line(s) ticked, {{amount}}. Recorded against those lines, so they are the ones that show as settled.
billing.familiesMovedHint: Looking for a household? Open the Year tab and press a child’s name — it opens the same record, and shows their class and paid months too.

family.title: Parent Portal
family.subtitle: Your children, balance, and payments
family.kioskHint: At the kiosk or on the masjid’s donation site, type a child’s Student ID and check the name it shows — you can pay for any of your children from there.
family.noFamily: Your account isn’t linked to a family yet. Please contact the office.
family.acceptGreeting: Welcome, {{name}}. Choose a password to finish setting up your account.
family.inviteInvalid: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Please ask the office for a new one.
family.registerUnavailable: Self sign-up isn’t available yet. Please ask the office for a portal invite link.
family.registerSubtitle: Enter your child’s Student ID, plus an email the school has on file for you. We’ll email you a link to set up your account.
family.registerStudentIdHint: Three letters and four digits, like YUS1234 — it’s on your statement.
family.registerEmailHint: Must be an email the office already has for your family.
family.registerSent: If those details match our records, we’ve emailed you a link to set up your account. Please check your inbox.
family.loadError: We couldn’t load your family right now. Please try again in a moment.
family.payAheadHint: Nothing is due right now. Anything you pay is held on your account and comes off your next invoice automatically.
family.payError: That payment couldn’t be completed. Please try again.
family.paidOptimistic: Payment received — it’ll show on your account in a moment. Thank you.
family.autopayTabSub: Save a card, and let tuition pay itself
family.autopaySetUpHint: Save a card once and tuition pays itself when it’s due.
family.autopayOnCard: We’ll charge your {{card}} when tuition is due.
family.autopayNeedsCard: Add a card first, then you can switch it on.
family.autopayOn: On — we’ll charge your default card when tuition is due.
family.autopayConsent: When on, your default card is charged automatically when tuition comes due. Turn it off any time.

admissions.invoiceNeedsFee: Pick a fee plan and fill in the invoice details.
admissions.enrolledInvoicePending: Enrolled — the student’s ID is {{studentCode}}. The first invoice couldn’t be generated; create it in Billing.

apply.title: Admission enquiry
apply.subtitle: Tell us about your child — the office will be in touch.
apply.error: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
apply.thanksBody: We’ve received your enquiry. The office will be in touch soon, in shā’ Allāh.

midyear.title: Starting mid-year
midyear.banner: Joining part-way through the year? Record what each child already owes or has paid, in one pass, before you bill your first month.
midyear.step1Hint: Months before this are never billed here — whatever each child brings with them is recorded once, below. This is also how we make sure an earlier month cannot be billed twice later on.
midyear.alreadyFloor: This install already bills from {{period}} onwards.
midyear.needsYear: Set up a school year on the Structure tab first — the months come from it.
midyear.step2: 2. What has each child already paid?
midyear.step2Hint: Pick the last month they are square for. We work out the rest from their own rate — and if the book says otherwise, type the amount instead.
midyear.step3Hint: These are the balances this will produce. Nothing has been written yet.
midyear.commitHint: Writes one dated record per child and bills from {{period}} onwards.
midyear.doneBody_one: {{count}} child carried a balance forward and {{ahead}} were already paid ahead. Billing starts at {{period}}.
midyear.doneBody_other: {{count}} children carried a balance forward and {{ahead}} were already paid ahead. Billing starts at {{period}}.
midyear.doneSkipped_one: {{count}} child already had a record and was left alone.
midyear.doneSkipped_other: {{count}} children already had a record and were left alone.
midyear.doneNext: Next: generate {{period}} on the Billing tab. Anything earlier is refused, so the balances you just recorded cannot be billed twice.
